name: reel
title: Reel
description: A portrait story viewer: full-bleed photos or video, a header with an avatar and handle, thin progress segments along the top, a caption footer, and previous, play, next and mute buttons.
use: A site wants to present a short sequence of photos or clips as a story with clear timing and captions.
avoid: It relies on remote media with no loading or error state, so a failed slide shows black with only its caption.
a11y: Icon buttons are labelled, but the full-size tap area is an unnamed button with no focus style and slides advance regardless of motion preference. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall rounded 9:16 panel on black, filled by a photo under dark top and bottom gradients. A row of thin progress bars runs across the top beneath an avatar and handle, and small round icon buttons line the bottom edge.
behaves: The bar for the current slide fills over that item's duration and then moves to the next, wrapping at the end. Clicking the left or right half of the picture steps back or forward, and the bottom row pauses, plays, mutes or skips.
customise: Pass a data array of items with id, type, src and duration, plus controlled index, playing and muted props. Overlay parts are children and slides render through a callback.
weight: light: One media element at a time plus a requestAnimationFrame tick for the progress.
demo: Maya Chen's Italy trip: Dolomites, a coast video, Lago di Braies and a city street.
issues: The coast video never appears: two frames are black apart from the caption and controls.
Captions are out of step with the pictures, so the coast text sits over mountain and forest photos.
Media failures are silent, with no loading or error placeholder for a slide.
polishWhy: Familiar story chrome, but the recording shows black slides and captions over the wrong photos.

frames.note: Two slides show black where media should be, and captions sit over the wrong photos.
